prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one square full-bleed anime mechanical roguelike card reference.
The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET. The user says this currently reads as a simple explosion and must instead read as DEFLAGRATION OF AN ALREADY BURNING ENEMY: “这看起来只是简单的爆炸，没有灼烧等效果，应该是爆燃，而不是爆炸”.

PRIMARY CHANGE: rebuild the central effect and related surfaces so the Pioneer is unmistakably suffering SUSTAINED COMBUSTION over its body and then a sudden vigorous FLARE-UP. Fire must visibly cling to, flow over and vent from multiple parts of the machine. This is not an instantaneous white-hot detonation with an otherwise clean robot.
Show connected orange tongues and broad translucent flame sheets licking upward and curling along the ivory/burgundy hull, beneath lifted armor edges, across both gun mounting bases and around several leg joints. Establish clearly separate attached burning zones at the upper hull, left gun base, right shoulder seam and front hip/leg. These zones belong to ONE continuing burning status, not floating fire icons or magical effects. Preserve the machinery underneath through readable gaps in the flame.
Make the armor look HEAT-AFFECTED: localized dark umber/charcoal scorch gradients around vents, glowing orange-red metal edges, dull cherry-hot seams between armor panels, small smoldering points and trails of glowing embers. Keep original ivory and burgundy visible on cooler regions so the unit retains its identity. Matte armor and hard cel-shaded values remain recognizable.
The sudden burst originates from those already burning seams: a forceful orange/amber surge of flame rolls out of the hull and expands into a curling flame front around the machine, with a few pale-cream hot highlights. Flame lobes overlap, stretch and peel upward, suggesting a combustible flare that continues burning after the surge. Give the flames strong shape and layered orange/red/pale-yellow regions. Use an outer thin fiery pressure arc and heat ripples as secondary cues, not a giant plain white shock ring.
Replace the existing central white starburst and gaping empty blown-out chest with an intensely glowing but READABLE internal burning cavity, connected dark chassis braces and partially raised armor panels. The overall body should remain a coherent recognizable machine amid the flare, not a fully disassembled corpse. Reduce the emphasis on flying shrapnel and radial explosive sparkle rays. Keep a few large foreground fragments but make their edges incandescent and carry visible trailing flames and embers; most of the visual energy should come from continuous attached fire.
Smoke comes from the burning surfaces and follows the upward curl of the flames: layered readable gray/rose-gray wisps, with some dark burnt wisps near the vents. Do not hide the unit in an opaque smoke ball. Warm reflected firelight strikes the nearby armor, gun barrels and ground.

Preserve the central Pioneer's identity and composition: ivory rounded armored body, burgundy armor regions, FOUR articulated mechanical legs, paired black side-mounted multi-barrel guns and two thin antennas. Maintain the dynamic low three-quarter camera and strong near/mid/far perspective. Keep the two smaller Pioneers in the background reacting to the heat/pressure wave, without making them additional full fireballs. Keep sunlit grass, ruined stone arches, blue sky, foreground depth and the square framing; allow local reconstruction of the central machine and effects to prioritize the user's burning/flare-up requirement.
Style: match the original crisp dark mechanical outlines, clean matte color blocks, three discrete cel-shaded values and bright readable anime card illustration. No photoreal grunge or dense random texture.
Palette: retain ivory #FEE4D9 and burgundy #A34053/#662249, dark mechanical #2C3735; sustained flame uses #EE9D58 and #8E3A2A with restrained #FEE4D9 hot cores and warm derived emissive shades. Pale smoke can derive from #EABCBA and #835061. Preserve the cool blue-gray/teal environment.

One finished opaque square illustration. No text, title, labels, watermark, card frame, UI, collage or arrows. No humans, blood or gore. Avoid a giant spherical fireball, whiteout starburst, nuclear detonation, clean unburnt legs under an isolated chest explosion, all-orange silhouette, magical aura and scattered confetti. The first visual read must be an ENEMY ENGULFED IN CONTINUING FLAMES DURING A SUDDEN FLARE-UP.
